source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The move-test setup calls setupBasicGraphTestServer({}), but the actual helper has no parameters and never reads arguments. The object therefore configures nothing in this phase. The reviewer questions the mismatch and the author acknowledges it; future argument support is only speculation. Accepted source keeps the same call and signature. Scope the call to the real helper contract rather than infer an options API from a neighboring EWS setup helper. No test was run.
title: The Graph move test passes an object to a zero-argument setup helper
